en.title: Who Are We?
en.description: Point at who fits best. No wrong answers — just a good way to actually get to know each other.
rules: Draw one card at a time.
Read the question out loud.
Everyone points at who fits best.
The one pointed at can agree, disagree, or tell the real story.
No wrong answers — it's all about getting to know each other!
